railway_deployment_status_truthful.evidence: root cause confirmed at the exact byte level: Railway's '●' status bullet is U+25CF, UTF-8-encoded as bytes E2 97 8F; byte 0x8F alone is undefined in cp1252, the codepage subprocess.run(text=True) fell back to without an explicit encoding. Separately fixed the conflation of decoding/timeout uncertainty with deployment failure: _decide_deployment_outcome() now treats an independent production HTTP check as primary evidence, CLI polling as corroborating only, with a genuine DEPLOYMENT_STATUS_UNKNOWN outcome for real ambiguity (added to TERMINAL_RUN_STATES and audited into sessions_data.py + trainer.js). 9 new focused tests (agent/test_web_server.py) each proven to fail against the pre-fix behavior; full regression 85/85 Python + 14/14 JS.
